mechanisms.name: stress concentration at sharp needle tips

evidence.quote: the needle-shaped Heusler-phase has sharp tips at which stress overload leads to the beginning of fracture, because the hard Heusler-phase has only a few slip systems and is therefore difficult to deform plastically by dislocation movement
